app_tagline: Typst notes on a page that draws itself while you type
no_folder: Open a folder with your notes first.
no_note: Open a note from the list or create a sample note.
click_note: Pick a note to start writing.
last_good_kept: The last good page stays on screen beside the note from Typst.
confirm_delete: Delete this note or folder? A folder takes everything inside it with it. You cannot undo this.
place_is_root: New notes go in the open folder.
move_hint: Type a new name, or a path such as folder/name.typ, to move it.
empty_tree: This folder has no notes yet.
clear_place: Put new notes in the open folder
conflict_body: Another tool changed this note on disk. Autosave is paused so your typing is not written over that change.
reload_warning: Reload replaces the edits that are still only in this window.
save_failed_body: The last save did not land, so this note stays open. Try saving again, or leave this note without saving those edits.
recent_empty: Notes you open show up here.
recent_failed: Recent notes could not be read
template_folder_unavailable: The templates folder cannot be used. Templates from the app still work.
template_names_exhausted: No free name for a template copy.
pdf_needs_note: PDF export needs a note, not a template.
template_failed: The template did not create a note
template_lecture_body: A title, a date, the lecturer, and room for definitions and theorems.
template_problem_set_body: Numbered problems with room for a solution and an answer.
template_lab_body: The aim, the equipment, a measurements table, uncertainty, and conclusions.
page_color_hint: The page keeps this colour inside a dark window.
appearance_preview: A short sample on the page.
